2609.24757.title: NPU Accelerator: Quantized Real-Time Vehicle Detection on PYNQ-Z1 Using FINN
2609.24757.paper_summary: This paper presents the design, optimization, implementation, and on-board validation of a neural processing unit (NPU) accelerator for real-time vehicle detection on the resource-constrained Xilinx Zynq XC7Z020 device of the PYNQ-Z1 board. The work follows a hardware/software co-design methodology that combines quantization-aware training (QAT), lightweight YOLO-derived detectors, Brevitas/QONNX model export, FINN dataflow compilation, Vivado implementation, and physical benchmarking on the target board. Four simultaneous engineering requirements define successful deployment: throughput above 30 frames/s (FPS), energy efficiency above 7 FPS/W, programmable-logic (PL) hardware latency below 50 ms, and Pascal VOC detection accuracy above 0.55 mAP@0.5. The design space includes LP-YOLO and LP-YOLO Slim variants, a custom YOLOv3-tiny reference, 4-bit and mixed low-bit quantization, 320$\times$320 and 256$\times$256 inputs, manual and automatic FIFO sizing, and programmable-logic clocks from 100 to 200 MHz. The final LP-YOLO Slim configuration uses a 256$\times$256 input, w2a4 quantization, and a 142.86 MHz PL clock. With batch 100 it reaches 35.66 FPS at 2.91 W, corresponding to 12.25 FPS/W, while measured PL latency is 45.11 ms and VOC mAP@0.5 is 0.594. This is the only evaluated configuration for which the supplied measurements satisfy all four requirements simultaneously. The results show that low-bit QAT, architectural slimming, FINN folding and FIFO optimization, and moderate clock scaling can jointly provide a practical real-time detector on a small Zynq FPGA.
2609.24757.paper_summary_zh: 本文介紹了一個神經處理單元（NPU）加速器的設計、優化、實現和機載驗證，該加速器用於在資源受限的 Xilinx Zynq XC7Z020 設備上的實時車輛檢測，該設備位於 PYNQ-Z1 板上。這項工作遵循硬體/軟體協同設計的方法論，結合了量化感知訓練（QAT）、輕量級 YOLO 衍生檢測器、Brevitas/QONNX 模型導出、FINN 數據流編譯、Vivado 實現以及在目標板上的物理基準測試。四個同時的工程需求定義了成功的部署：吞吐量超過 30 幀/秒（FPS）、能量效率超過 7 FPS/W、可編程邏輯（PL）硬體延遲低於 50 毫秒，以及 Pascal VOC 檢測準確度超過 0.55 mAP@0.5。設計空間包括 LP-YOLO 和 LP-YOLO Slim 變體、自定義 YOLOv3-tiny 參考、4 位和混合低位量化、320$\times$320 和 256$\times$256 輸入、手動和自動 FIFO 大小調整，以及 100 到 200 MHz 的可編程邏輯時鐘。最終的 LP-YOLO Slim 配置使用 256$\times$256 輸入、w2a4 量化和 142.86 MHz 的 PL 時鐘。在批次 100 時，它達到了 35.66 FPS，功耗為 2.91 W，相當於 12.25 FPS/W，同時測得的 PL 延遲為 45.11 毫秒，VOC mAP@0.5 為 0.594。這是唯一評估的配置，所提供的測量滿足所有四個要求。結果顯示，低位 QAT、架構精簡、FINN 折疊和 FIFO 優化以及適度的時鐘縮放可以共同提供一個實用的實時檢測器，適用於小型 Zynq FPGA。
